payload.title: Route reviews per output instead of per item
payload.description:
Only send the reviewer the unsure questions on the checklist, not every question for an item where one answer is unsure.

Current: selection uses the minimum confidence across outputs and selects the whole item (embedded_cyclotron.py:427-430; review_program.py:113-125).

Desired: per-output selection (below threshold or sampled); the decision records which outputs are requested.

Acceptance: confident A + unsure B requests only B; audit sampling stays per output with propensities; replay deterministic.
